name: miaoda-game-reward-core
description: Engine-agnostic weighted-random reward toolkit: weighted tables with published odds, nested/recursive loot tables (multi-roll, unique-per-batch), independent per-entry drop rolls, and a reusable soft+hard pity counter plus a full gacha banner (rarity pity + featured 50/50 rate-up). Seeded and fully serializable for reproducible tests and save games. No rendering, no engine dependency. Backs gacha, ARPG loot, roguelike item pools, chest/card-pack openings and random quest rewards.
